verdict.rationale: TruffleHog supports custom regex-based detectors with optional webhook verification (trufflehog-docs-6, trufflehog-docs-27), which is a simple syntax for defining new detection rules, and these can be invoked via a shared config.yaml file (trufflehog-docs-14) that could be reused across multiple repository scans. However this is secret-detection-focused (not general SAST), and there's no documented first-class mechanism for packaging/distributing/versioning these rules as a shared ruleset across teams or repos beyond copying a config file. Missing for 10: a dedicated rule-sharing/registry mechanism, richer rule syntax beyond regex, and independent evidence of teams actually sharing custom detector configs across repos.
